scenes.title: A pod that holds nothing
scenes.heading: A pod that holds nothing
scenes.narration: At the seed bank, one pod is empty, three pods hold two seeds apiece and two pods hold five apiece. An empty pod gets its own row in the ledger. Does it contribute to the number of seeds, the number of pods, or both?

scenes.title: Make every copy visible
scenes.heading: Make every copy visible
scenes.narration: The empty pod adds zero seeds and one pod. Three copies of two contribute six seeds. Two copies of five contribute ten. There are sixteen seeds shared across six pods. The mean is sixteen divided by six, or two and two thirds seeds per pod.

scenes.title: What the row label misses
scenes.heading: What the row label misses
scenes.narration: Suppose you average the three printed row labels, zero, two and five. Their sum is seven and you divide by three. Which sample could that describe? Compare those three equal weights with the actual numbers of pods.

scenes.title: Give the pod its vote
scenes.heading: Give the pod its vote
scenes.narration: Averaging the labels would describe one pod of each kind. Our trays contain one, three and two. Write the frequency beside each value. Add the numbers of pods for the denominator, and add the products of value and frequency for the numerator.

scenes.title: The missing frequency
scenes.heading: The missing frequency
scenes.narration: A fresh tray has one empty pod, five pods with two seeds each, and some pods with five seeds each. The mean is exactly two and a half seeds per pod. The count of five seed pods is smudged. Can you recover it without guessing possible tray sizes?

scenes.title: Measure a shortfall
scenes.heading: Measure a shortfall
scenes.narration: Compare each observed pod with the mean of two and a half. The empty pod is short by two and a half seeds. Each two seed pod is short by half a seed. The five together are short by another two and a half. The combined shortfall is five seeds.

scenes.title: Balance the surplus
scenes.heading: Balance the surplus
scenes.narration: A five seed pod contributes two and a half seeds above the mean. Two such pods balance the five seed shortfall. The missing frequency is two. Verify the ordinary way: one plus five plus two makes eight pods, and their seed total is twenty.

scenes.title: Check the ledger
scenes.heading: Check the ledger
scenes.narration: Twenty divided by eight is two and a half. The fractional mean describes an equal share. Individual pods can still contain whole seeds. A zero reading adds one observation, and a missing frequency tells you how many copies of one reading to restore.
